reason: The plugin primarily automates restarting the DeepSeek Harness process, with agent and UI triggers, configurable continuation behavior, and an optional watchdog for relaunching it.

summaries.zh: 用于通过智能体工具或界面命令重启 DeepSeek Harness，并配置重启后的继续提示与可选看门狗拉起功能。
summaries.en: Restarts the DeepSeek Harness through an agent tool or UI command and configures continuation prompts and an optional process watchdog.

capabilities: Restart the DeepSeek Harness process on agent request or through a slash command
Persist restart and continuation settings to settings.yaml
Optionally relaunch the process after a crash or shutdown using a watchdog
Support a legacy PowerShell/WMI/taskkill restart method
